producer_identity_method: original_transfer_receipt_source_path_and_target_path_plus_fresh_target_bytes; no merge across different producer source paths
retention_policy: joint all surviving directories by original producer; preserve first and last and shortest unusual internal fragment; preserve already-minimal sets
fresh_execution_requirements: root performs exact lstat equality of bytes/device/inode/nlink/mtime_ns before unlink
root confirms no selected file is open by active owned process
no recursive directory deletion; unlink exact listed regular files only
new errors and actual receipts must be appended and Git archived by root
